purpose: Combined task and architecture overview with schematic G1-style robot elements
initial_prompt:
Create a polished, information-rich scientific paper overview figure for ForeDance, landscape approximately 1.8:1, crisp high-resolution typography, white background, refined restrained publication graphic design. Title small upper left "ForeDance" and subtitle "Anticipatory music conditioning for streaming dance generation". Visual identity: an unfolding musical score/time ribbon, teal music, deep blue discrete structure, amber continuous detail, muted violet committed state. Elegant thin connectors, clear visual hierarchy, readable at full two-column paper width. Not a poster or futuristic dashboard.

Reference image 1 is ONLY a reference for humanoid robot appearance and the correct body-part supervision illustration, NOT a layout to copy. Include recognizable compact silver G1-style humanoids, articulated mechanical limbs and black face visor, neutral heads. Robots must be anatomical schematics, never photographs or experimental results.

Layout three horizontal zones:
(a) top 22 percent: heading "Anticipate from heard music". A teal waveform strip on left labeled "Heard audio", a vertical dashed line "Now", and rightward dashed teal forecast-state tiles labeled "Predicted music states". Between heard input and predicted states a small box "Frozen music forecaster". Future is represented by predicted latent tiles, NOT an observed future waveform. Subtle musical staff lines unite the ribbon.
(b) middle 43 percent: heading "Generate, commit, continue". Main architecture reads left to right. A left box "Committed history + reference state" feeds a blue "Structure planner" box above an amber "Detail generator" box. Predicted music states from (a) branch down with two clear arrowheads, one into Structure planner and one into Detail generator. Structure planner outputs blue tiles labeled "e(q)" and also a short down arrow into Detail generator; Detail generator outputs amber tiles labeled "r". Both tile paths converge at a single circled plus then into a SINGLE box "Shared decoder" then a violet box "Commit prefix". A separate thin violet input from reference state feeds Shared decoder. To the right of Commit prefix, show three appealing silver G1-style robot dance poses progressing along a quiet timeline, blue lower body/waist and amber arms, with one continuous output ribbon labeled "Streaming reference motion". Robot illustrations schematic, no ground-contact claims. A violet return arrow from Commit prefix along bottom of zone (b) labeled "Update history + reconstruct state" goes back to the input context box; this feedback is generated reference context, no physical robot sensor feedback. Leave connectors enough whitespace. No controller.
(c) bottom 35 percent: two distinct pale panels, not connected into inference arrows.
Left panel heading "D+C: kinematics-guided training". Two small robot anatomical diagrams side by side: "Joint view" colors root/legs/waist blue and arms amber; "Geometry view" a neutral silver robot with exactly five blue landmarks on torso center, both wrists, and bottom of both feet, other body landmarks amber. Under them two compact rows "e(q) + r → Full-view reconstruction" and "e(q) → Structural-view reconstruction". Bottom note "Shared decoder; complementary supervision views". These views are not hard isolated body decoders. Do NOT include corrupted detail branch.
Right panel heading "CoF: learn after committing". Four clean steps connected left-to-right "Sample" → "Commit" → "Reconstruct state" → "Train next plan". Blue+amber paired token strip under Sample, violet bracket under Commit. A thin label under first three steps "Generated transition · stop gradient"; separate dataset target arrow ONLY into Train next plan from a label "Recorded target". Bottom note "Generated history and state stay paired".
Footer tiny simple legend blue "Structure" amber "Detail" teal "Music" violet "Commit / state"; note "Robot poses are schematic".
Prioritize accurately directed dataflow, polished spacious grouping, informative humanoid robot elements, elegant balanced visual interest. Do not include scores, performance claims, corrupted detail, future observed audio, FHC, MMR, hardware execution photos, watermarks, extra panels, excessive text, dark backgrounds, decoration that obscures arrows.
revision_prompt: Edit this ForeDance paper figure with ONE precise dataflow correction only. In panel (b), the teal input labeled 'Predicted music states (from a)' MUST condition BOTH the blue Structure planner and amber Detail generator. Preserve the existing teal arrow into Structure planner. Extend a distinct teal branch down the left side of the two planner boxes and add a clearly visible teal right-pointing arrowhead entering the LEFT edge of the amber Detail generator, just ABOVE its existing black context arrow. Route this teal branch away from the black committed-history lines so both colors are distinguishable; minimal local spacing adjustment allowed. Two separate teal arrowheads, one into each box, are essential. Keep all other elements, text, colors, robot diagrams, layout, structure-to-detail arrow, shared decoder, existing context inputs, training panels and footer unchanged. Do not add any extra components.
